description: This file defines the PayloadBuilder interface for constructing Payload instances with various optional attributes, used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter component.

classes.name: PayloadBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder pattern for creating Payload objects with optional properties such as value, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields.

methods.name: withValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the payload, replacing any previous value.

methods.name: withExtra
methods.description: Sets additional payload information as a JsonObject, replacing previous extra info.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Sets HTTP status for the payload, either as an HttpStatusCode or an integer value.

methods.name: withRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision number for the payload.

methods.name: withTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the payload.

methods.name: withMetadata
methods.description: Sets metadata information for the payload.

methods.name: withFields
methods.description: Sets fields to include in the payload, either via JsonFieldSelector or String.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns a Payload object with the specified properties.
